title: Dynamics 365 Business Central Blog Series: TableRelation
summary: This post is an index of the author's articles on the TableRelation property in Business Central. The linked articles cover how it differs from Enum/Option, Lookup and AssistEdit on pages, extending it through table extensions, a primary key validation error, entering values without validation, and missing read permissions. Others cover exporting all relations, for example for the Customer table, building lookup and option lists, and the Record.Relation method.
key_points: The post is a list of links to earlier TableRelation articles, each with its publication date
Topics include how TableRelation, Enum/Option, Lookup and AssistEdit differ in the page UI
Other entries cover table extensions, a primary key validation error, and entering values without relation validation
Further entries cover missing read permission on the related table, exporting all relations for a table such as Customer, and the Record.Relation method
